hospitalName.title: Hospital / Clinic Name
hospitalName.description: Facility for the visit — used as the calendar Event location.

notes.title: Objective / Notes
notes.description: What the rep plans to discuss — product, key ask, follow-up from previous visit.

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Doctor to visit. Use the name from the current session if not restated.

preferredDate.title: Preferred Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
preferredDate.description: Parse from rep's words: 'tomorrow' = +1 day, 'next week' = +7 days, 'next Monday' = next Monday. Leave blank to default to 3 working days from today.
